preset.name: macos-clang-universal-cpu-only
preset.comment: macOS Universal Binary (x86_64 + ARM64) clang PhysX SDK general settings (cpu only)

cmakeSwitch.name: PX_BUILDSNIPPETS
cmakeSwitch.comment: Generate the snippets (now working with OpenGL fixes)

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX

cmakeParam.name: CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET
cmakeParam.comment: Minimum macOS version supporting both architectures
